name: Preparation of Dark Magic
effect:
Add 1 Spell Card from your Deck or GY that mentions “Dark Magician” in its text to your hand. Then, if “Dark Magician” is on your field or in your GY, you can also add 1 Level 1 Spellcaster monster with 0 ATK and 0 DEF from your Deck to your hand.
If this card is in your GY: You can banish it; place 1 “Eternal Soul” face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone from your Deck, hand, or GY.
You can only use each effect of “Preparation of Dark Magic” once per turn.
